name: Oshkosh Airport Products
old_description: Today, Oshkosh Corporation is revered as a leading designer and manufacturer of the world's toughest specialty trucks, truck bodies and access equipment. No one understands extreme conditions like Oshkosh, which is why no one builds fire and emergency apparatus, defense vehicles and commercial and access equipment better.
about:
Oshkosh Airport Products is based in Neenah, Wisconsin, and operates as a division of Oshkosh Corporation. The exact founding year of the Airport Products unit is not publicly disclosed, but the parent company traces its roots to 1917 in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. The business focuses on the design and manufacture of aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF) vehicles for airport operators worldwide.

The company produces the Striker® line of ARFF trucks, including the Striker Volterra® electric variant, along with stock ARFF trucks for immediate delivery. Its product portfolio features proprietary technologies such as the ECO EFP™ foam system, K-Factor™ agent proportioning, ClearSky Intelligence™ telematics, the Snozzle® high-reach extendable turret, and the Tak-4® independent suspension. Support is delivered through a dealer network that the company describes as the largest in the airport industry, providing training, parts, and aftermarket service backed by OEM-limited warranties. Over 250 service documents are available for technical reference.

Primary customers are municipal and commercial airports, as well as government agencies that procure through cooperative purchasing programs including HGAC, Sourcewell, NPPGov, the Florida Sheriffs Association, and Ohio Buys. The trucks are built to meet the demanding performance requirements of ARFF operations at airports of all sizes.

Oshkosh Airport Products emphasizes its dealer network scale, factory-backed warranties, and a suite of integrated innovations—from electric drivetrains to advanced telematics—as the factors that differentiate its offering in the ARFF market.
